title: Interactive Fiction on Baize: Inform 7 bridge (Path C)
description: Alternative to ZIL: translate Inform 7 source (modern IF language) to Baize game definitions. Inform 7 has cleaner world model / behavior separation than ZIL. Community Inform 7 ports of Colossal Cave and Zork-likes exist. May be easier translation target. Speculative/crazy project.
